source.check: every name and label checked against the page image; returned unopposed, no poll

note: Triennial election of the rural district council (31 divisions), 1939: nominations received by J. A. Dawson, clerk, 25 April 1939; no contests. 19 members were nominated and the remaining 12 were deemed to be re-elected; the list printed does not say which were which. Returned unopposed. Formerly member for Ballyards; succeeds the late W. J. Todd, J.P.
